## R Markdown

To run files one a time click command + enter on the line. 
To run the entire code chunk, click command + shift + enter. 

```{r}

print("hello")
print(1+2)
print("1+2")

```

You can produce pdf documents by **knitting** this document.
To do this, click the **Knit** button (the one with the yarn) 

Now add your own code chunk, and print the following: 

1. "Truth Through the Science Looking Glass"
2. The output of 7 times 6. 
3. The words "7 times 6"
